notes.title: Bug Fixes, QoL changes, & Localisation Updates
notes.notes:
Regular update to fix bugs, improve quality of life, and finally update localisation!

Want to help out with localising MuseSwipr to other languages and get your name in the (soon-to-be-added) credits section of the game? Join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/NQ7UvKaU6z]Discord[/url][/b] and join the localisation and translation channel!

[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Volume can be changed anywhere by holding ALT and scroll-wheeling (previously this was also the case, but you could also just scroll anywhere and affect the volume which led to accidental volume changes quite often)  
[*]The tutorial is now skippable - though you won't get the tutorial completion achievement. Hold down Esc in the tutorial to skip and exit.
[*]Improved play data tracking!
[/list][b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Fixed bug where:
[list]
[*]after playing the tutorial, none of the bottom buttons would work  
[*]the song progress bar would sometimes disappear in autoplay mode  
[*]restore to default settings would not restore some settings to their defaults
[/list][b]Localisation Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated many untranslated texts in MuseSwipr to use localised texts (still a work in progress!)  
[*]Updated German localisation - [b]HUGE thanks[/b] to Veii, klave, and shanya for your localisation efforts!!  
[*]Added Indonesian localisation - and [b]another HUGE thanks[/b] to handofmyths for your contributions!!!  
[*]Updated Russian localisation - and [b]yet another HUGE thanks[/b] to ppiece of cat for providing updated translations!!!!  
[*]Updated missing translations with auto-translated texts. You can tell what text is auto-translated based on whether it has (A) in front of it or not. These are placeholders, and we aim to replace them with human translations in future updates.  
[*]And thanks again to everyone in the past who has ever contributed to localisations for MuseSwipr! We plan on adding a credits section soon in the game and will include everyone who has contributed so far.
[/list]If you'd like to help out with localisations (or just hang out with the amazing MuseSwipr community in general), join our [url=https://discord.gg/NQ7UvKaU6z]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: 🎉 Big Changes Coming to MuseSwipr! 🎶
notes.notes:
We’ve got some [b]exciting news[/b] to update you all with as we continue making the [b]MuseSwipr experience even better[/b]!

[h2]🎶 On-going MuseSwipr Editor Updates 🎶[/h2]

As some of you may know, we've been working on a [b]updated version of the MuseSwipr editor[/b] (known as "[b]Editor v2[/b]") which is currently separate from the MuseSwipr game itself. We're working hard behind the scenes on [b]Editor v2[/b], which will eventually be [b]built into the game[/b] - though, this is a [b]big project[/b].

As part of this ongoing update to MuseSwipr's editor, [b]we want to phase out 'v1' maps by removing Editor v1 (the current in-game editor) in the next update[/b]. 
In the mean time, you can still make your own [b]custom maps using Editor v2[/b] which you can grab from our [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/NQ7UvKaU6z]Discord[/url][/b], or the [b][url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1IQtTCEYl7eEXwqOLzSbsTJ2MHSG-Jfnt?usp=sharing]Google Drive link[/url][/b].

If you've got some Editor v1 maps you want to convert to the v2 format, here's what you can do:
1. Open the Timing Point Panel (F6) in your map
2. Hit Ctrl+G to copy your map
3. Paste them into Editor v2 with Ctrl+V

(V1 maps that are on the Steam workshop will continue to work, so no need worry about those!)
If you need any support, feel free to reach out to us on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/NQ7UvKaU6z]MuseSwipr Discord[/url]!

[h2]👀 What's Next? 👀[/h2]
Updates have been a little bit sparse, but that's because we have been working hard behind the scenes on big updates! We want the community to have something to look forward to though, so here's a sneak peek of some of the big things we're working on:

🎨 [b]UI visual overhaul[/b] - giving MuseSwipr a less... 'derivative' look when it comes to the user interface... and adding a ton of features based on feedback!

🏆 [b]Scoring updates, better leaderboards, and... a ranking system??[/b]

🎶 And of course, more [b]built-in songs from amazing featured artists[/b]!

We’re super excited about what’s coming next, and we couldn’t do it without our amazing community (speaking of, you should totally join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/NQ7UvKaU6z]Discord here: https://discord.com/invite/NQ7UvKaU6z[/url])

- Erkfir & Kartsu

notes.title: 🖥️ Enhanced Resolution Options + Full Screen Modes + Bug Fixes 🖥️ - May 3
notes.notes:
[h3]🖥️ Full Screen and Resolution Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where seesaw mod was not working on different resolutions.
[*] Changed the "Is Borderless" option to a dropdown for "Full-Screen Mode". Options include [b]Full Screen[/b], [b]Full Screen (Borderless)[/b], and [b]Windowed[/b].

[list]
[*] When [b]Full Screen[/b] is selected, the resolution dropdown only shows resolutions that match the aspect ratio of the native display (to prevent stretching). This full screen mode is also known as “exclusive full screen”.
[*] [b]Full Screen (borderless)[/b] and [b]Windowed[/b] will show all available resolutions up to and including the native resolution.
[*] Note that Full Screen (borderless and not borderless) does not do any letterboxing to render the game at your native resolution.
[/list]
[*] Fixed autoplay breaking with resolution changes
[*] Fixed seesaw being broken with resolution changes
[/list]

[h3]🛠️ Other Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed deleting Steam map packs resulting in “ghost” song panels
[*] Fixed skin editor not allowing the skin creator’s name to be changed.
[*] Increased the size of in-game chat slightly.
[*] Skin editor now will only accept sprites that have image dimensions of power of 2 (e.g., 256x256, 512x512, …) to reduce the number of issues with texture loading.
[*] Fixed difficulty sliders displaying the wrong values for newer maps.
[/list]

notes.title: Improved searching and Diff Calc, Screen Resolution fixes, Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Join our Discord community for progress updates on the performance system, rankings, and the new level editor! [url=https://discord.gg/NQ7UvKaU6z]https://discord.gg/NQ7UvKaU6z[/url]

[list]
[*] Difficulty calculation has been updated!
[olist]
[*] Higher weighting is given to the harder parts of maps.
[*] Fixed bugs causing some maps to become overly buffed/nerfed.
[/olist]
[*] Search strings have been added. 

The following search string format can now be used to filter by difficulty:
(star|stars|diff|difficulty)(=|<|>|<=|>=|!=)(float number)

[u][b]Usage examples:[/b][/u]
[olist]
[*] [b]`camellia stars>2 stars<5`[/b] to search for songs between 2 and 5 stars with 'camellia' in it
[*] [b]`star>9`[/b] to search for songs more than 9 stars
[*] [b]`no speculation`[/b] will look for maps with `no` or `speculation` in it while
[*] [b]`"no speculation"`[/b] will look for maps with `no speculation` in it`
[/olist]
[*] Fixed bug where menu screens were not properly scaled to the monitor's resolution.
[*] Fixed text overlapping issues when beatmap information had special characters.
[/list]

notes.title: Input calibration presets, Scroll Velocity fixes, QoL changes - Mar 13
notes.notes:
⦁ Speed and precision calibration presets have been added, which help you swipe faster or more accurately. They can be accessed from the options menu. Use ctrl - and ctrl = to cycle through presets.

⦁ Scroll velocity (SV) changes now work properly regardless of framerate. 

⦁ SV changes with durations as low as 1ms should now register and process properly.

⦁ Timing point fields in the level editor have been optimised for large numbers of timing points

⦁ Added functionality to copy all selected timing points into spreadsheet format using CTRL+C

⦁ Beatmap panels in song select are updated with steam workshop item updates (once the update is downloaded by steam)

⦁ Changes made to name/artist/difficulty in the level editor are shown in song select without having to restart the game

⦁ Hit input from turning has been slightly changed to occur 1 frame sooner (there was a 1 frame delay before).
